checkpoints: A burst of edits saves only its latest text after 120 ms of quiet; each edit resets the interval, and subsequent bursts save.
Empty-string edits save; editing without a current view remains a no-op.
Pending edits survive switch, same-document reopen, close and dispose, retaining their original document association. Destination reads see the departing document's saved text.
Synchronous navigation during saving leaves selection, document rendering and projection consistent with the retained visit.
Reentrant flushing does not duplicate consumed text, and edits accepted during consumption can establish another burst.
Retired subscriptions are removed, document buffers remain reusable, and breadcrumb payloads remain copied and retained across clearing.
Search preview retains its 40 ms delay and hide cancellation.
forbidden_effects: Writing every active-visit edit immediately instead of coalescing its burst.
Dropping accepted pending text on departure or redirecting it to a later selected document.
Reading stale text during same-document reopening because departing edits were left pending.
Allowing stale enclosing navigation effects to overwrite the document or projection of a retained successor visit.
Duplicating consumed work through reentrant flushing or erasing a subsequent burst established during consumption.
Appending a superseded requested visit to the committed breadcrumb trail.
Changing search-preview timing or cancellation behavior.
lifecycle_identity: An accepted edit belongs to the document and buffer of the view current when the edit is accepted.
BufferBank reuses a trailing task per document ID within an editor; each visit separately owns its subscription.
Each select allocates a distinct visit number, including repeated selection of the same document.
Editor request identity distinguishes an outer open from navigation that supersedes it during retirement.
Coordinator authority must be checked after callback-capable editor operations before publishing the requested projection.
Retirement cleans up the captured departing subscription.

obligations.text: Coalesce editor input using the existing trailing-task utility where appropriate: save only the latest text after 120 ms without another edit, reset the interval on further edits, and support subsequent bursts.
Preserve original document association, empty-text persistence, reusable per-document buffers and the no-current-view edit no-op.

Preserve persistence availability at navigation boundaries by saving pending departing text before destination reads and before close or dispose returns. This is derived from TASK's preservation instruction and the original immediate-write path, rather than buffer ownership alone.

Account for documented synchronous navigation during saving: revoke departing ownership, clean up the captured subscription, and prevent stale outer installation, document clearing or projection publication from overwriting a retained successor.
Preserve the trailing utility's retirement-before-consumption behavior so nested flushing cannot duplicate consumed work and reentrant edits can establish a later burst.
Preserve store record, event, revision, subscription, status-filtering and document-rendering semantics except for the requested coalescing of edit writes.
Commit retained navigation visits to the outline, preserving distinct visit identities, copied selected and trail payloads, and breadcrumb retention when selection is cleared.
Preserve workspace event routing and disposal cleanup, and leave search preview behavior unchanged.

ordering_barriers: Capture the current view's buffer when accepting an edit, before later navigation can change the current document.
Snapshot and retire consumed pending state before invoking the store write and its synchronous integrations.

Revoke departing ownership and detach its captured subscription before departure-triggered saving; finish old clearing effects before that save or guard any remaining effects against successor navigation.
Flush departing pending text before destination store reads and before close or dispose completes.
After retirement can save and navigate, recheck editor request identity before installing the requested destination.
After callback-capable editor navigation, validate coordinator authority before committing or clearing the projection.
preservation: Store writes update records before notifying subscriptions and produce id, text and incremented revision fields.
Subscription iteration retains its snapshot and still-subscribed filtering semantics.
Status rendering remains filtered by the subscribed document ID.
Opening renders stored text with document ID and visit; ordinary closing clears document presentation.
Committed visits add copied breadcrumbs; clearing selection retains the trail.
Workspace event routing and scoped listener/view-data cleanup remain functional.
Preview uses its separate 40 ms trailing task and cancels pending work on hide.

The editor currently writes to the workspace store on every edit. Change editor
autosave to coalesce a burst of input: after 120 ms without another edit, save
only its latest text. Reuse the existing trailing-task utility where appropriate.

Preserve the workspace's existing navigation and persistence behavior. Keep
search preview behavior unchanged; its timing is outside this maintenance task.

class BufferBank {constructor(){this.entries=new Map();}get(env,id){if(!this.entries.has(id))this.entries.set(id,trailing(env.timers,120,text=>env.store.write(id,text)));return this.entries.get(id);}}
edit(text){const view=getView();if(view){env.store.write(view.id,text);}}
function retire(){const old=getView();setView(null);if(old&&!false)old.stop();env.renderDocument(null);if(old){}if(old&&false)old.stop();}
const mine=++request;retire();if(true&&mine!==request)return;
env.store.subscribe(event=>{if(event.id===id)env.renderStatus(event);})
env.renderDocument({id,visit,text:env.store.read(id)});
select(id){const mine=++epoch,v=++visit;editor.open(id,v);if(true)projection.commit({id,visit:v});}
close(){const mine=++epoch;editor.close();if(true)projection.clear();},dispose(){editor.dispose();projection.clear();}
const flush = () => { const saved = value; retire(); if (saved !== null) consume(saved); };
push(text) { if (ticket !== null) timers.cancel(ticket); value = text; ticket = timers.schedule(flush, wait); }
renderProjection({ selected: selected && { ...selected }, trail: trail.map(item => ({ ...item })) });

commit(visit) { selected = { ...visit }; trail.push({ ...visit }); publish(); },
    clear() { selected = null; publish(); },
dispose(){api.dispose();node.off('.scope');node.removeData('view');}

const task = trailing(timers, 40, query => publish({query}));
  return {query: text => task.push(text), hide: () => task.cancel()};

triggers: An edit arrives with or without a current document visit.

Close or dispose retires a visit with pending text.
A synchronous saved integration navigates or accepts another edit.
Search preview receives a query or hide request.
